'''Boskirn''' was a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who earned the nickname of '''"Bantha" Boskirn''' because of his size and lack of speed. While performing several jobs on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bantha/Legends|lumbering creature]] that Boskirn was nicknamed after,<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Boskirn grew angry with a [[Unidentified smuggler (Boskirn)|smuggler]] who mocked his nickname. Boskirn attempted to draw his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], but he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] shot the Houk before he could fire his weapon.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boskirn was mentioned in the Codex entry for the bantha in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
